quests.title: Moonlight Sonata

dialogue.t: Greetings.
Huh? Are you heading out, Columbina?
Yes. I need to get a lyre repaired.
...What?
One of the kuuhenki's lyres is broken. She greatly values this lyre, so I wish to have it restored.
Man, kuuhenki sure are multi-talented...
Of course. This little one often performs around here, and I sometimes sing along.
Y'know, Paimon's been thinking this for a while, but you sure do spoil the kuuhenki.
Well, it's only right. They have kept me company all this time, and often bring me amusing objects as well.

dialogue.sit: (Lauma told me about this before — the natural instinct of kuuhenki to make the Moon Goddesses happy.)

dialogue.t: If you don't mind Paimon asking, how do you plan to fix this lyre? Didn't you say you didn't want to be seen by others?
Hmm... In the past, small animals or kuuhenki would help deliver broken objects to an artisan's doorstep for me.
All I had to do was wait for the artisan to find it. Of course, sometimes, that would take a few days.
Seems like a roundabout way of doing things...

dialogue.sit: Why don't you let us handle it?

dialogue.t: Yeah, just leave it to us. Who knows, we might even be able to get this done today.
...Very well. Thank you.
Our pleasure! By the way, what artisan do you usually bring your stuff to?
I don't know her name, but there's a large mechanical hand by her door, and she lives in a round, conch-like home.
The aroma of krumkakes often wafts from within as well.
Yep, that clears it up for sure...

dialogue.sit: (Hmm? Music from a lyre? It seems Columbina is playing for the kuuhenki.)
(The last time we popped by, the lyre hadn't been repaired yet. That was well before Columbina got to know everyone...)

dialogue.t: Aino? Are you home?
Wait, Paimon? Is that you?
What brings you here, guys? Bring me any snacks?
Paimon knew you'd say that! Here, we got you these on the way.
Quick, hand 'em over! Ineffa's gonna be back soon.
So, you here to hang out? What sorta fun things should we do?
Hehe... Actually, we need your help with something...
Waaah! Get... Get that weird thing away from me!
"Weird thing"? You mean this lyre?
I told you, I don't mess with stuff that science and mechanics can't explain...
I'm telling you, that lyre just... shows up on my doorstep at random. And, after I fix it, the thing up and disappears!
N—Not that I believe in spooky, superstitious stuff like that!
Ah, okay... Seems like there's some sort of misunderstanding here...
What do you mean?

dialogue.sit: This lyre belongs to a friend...
A friend who's a bit scared of strangers...

dialogue.t: Yeah. She doesn't mean any harm, she just... has her reasons for taking the lyre back without being seen...
Really? You better not be making this up.
Fine. I'm... I'm trusting you on this! I'll fix this thing for you, and this time, I'll try to make it last...
Wait for me here. I'll be right back.
Knew we could count on Aino! Paimon feels a little bad Columbina's random item drop-offs had her so freaked out though...
Yes, she deserves something in return.
Exactl— Aaah! What are you doing here!? You scared us!
I have something to give you.
Hmm? What are these?
A few trinkets the kuuhenki collected. I thought the artisan might like them. Perhaps you could give them to her as thanks.
Ohhh... What a weird collection of components. Yeah, alright! We'll pass 'em along!
Take care on your way back! There could be people around here.
Huh? What is it?
...Analyzing appearance...
What are you doing that for!?
Match found: Resemblance to Nod-Krai Moon Goddess Statues is 95%...

dialogue.sit: What about the, uh, margin of error?

dialogue.t: Increased heart rate detected in "{NICKNAME}"...
Okay, all fixed! Did a pretty bang up job, if I do say so myself. It shouldn't break ever again! Also, about those sna— O—Oh! I—Ineffa...!
What was that last part, Aino?
Uh, those sna... zzy new components worked great, too!
Uh, who's that behind you?

dialogue.sit: The person who needed the lyre fixed!

dialogue.t: (Huh, she kinda looks familiar... Have I seen her before? Eh, whatever. The most important thing is, I hid those snacks Paimon gave me...)
Th—That's right! Also, she wanted you to have these components as thanks for fixing the lyre, Aino.
Ooh, lemme see... Wow! These are rare, and so old! You sure I can take them?
...Yes.
Thank you so much! If you ever need anything else fixed, just come find me — no need to be shy!
Well, um... We've got places to be, so uh... Aino, Ineffa, we'll swing by some other day, okay?
(We've gotta get The Damselette outta here, or Ineffa will recognize her for sure!)
Oh, sure! See you some other time!
(I've gotta do some cleanup quick, or Ineffa's gonna find the snack crumbs!)
Alright. Until next time.
...Aino.
Uh... yeah?
Would you like to frame these components or preserve them in any way?
What? Why would I do that?
They appear to be "gifts from the Moon Goddess."
Huh? What are you talking about...? Remind me to check your circuits later...
You appear acquainted with that artisan. I shall await you here.

quests.description: The Damselette is having a spot of trouble in the Silvermoon Hall…
